arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    c.country,
    SUM(o.total) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
